verdict.rationale:
Zep's core workflow directly matches the story: thread.add_messages() ingests conversation turns into a persistent user-level Context Graph (zep-docs-20, zep-docs-48), and retrieval uses combined semantic similarity + BM25 full-text search over that graph (zep-docs-9, zep-docs-22) with sub-200ms latency (zep-docs-34) and cross-session persistence via Users/Threads (zep-docs-19). Community commentary corroborates the graph-based approach was built specifically to improve recall over prior fact-extraction methods (zep-comm-1), with general skepticism about memory hallucination in the category (zep-comm-6) but no concrete evidence Zep specifically fails at semantic recall.
